capabilities: Display live MQTT and REST API data in notes via a livedata code block
Poll REST endpoints with configurable interval, caching and retries
Insert widgets through a command-palette wizard and migrate legacy block syntax
Show live/stale/offline status indicators and relative timestamps for data points
List all active data points in a sidebar overview
extras: Store installation is planned; currently installable as a beta via BRAT. README says TCP MQTT is desktop-only and credentials are session-only on mobile.
problem: Obsidian notes are static text; there is no built-in way to embed live external data such as sensor readings or API values in a note.

requires.name: MQTT broker or REST API endpoint

summary: Live-data widgets that render MQTT and REST API values inside notes via code blocks, updating in real time.
